topic: Dynamic DATE support body for calendar-varying finite-memory carryover. Fix finite periods, memory, absorbing treatment-path support, and a positive probability floor. Under consistency and pathwise conditional mean random assignment, define the exact coefficient-by-calendar-by-causal-lag loading tensor of unit/time fixed-effect regression and the normalized diagonal target tensor. Characterize the complete image generated by positive reshaping laws using the ordered Green/pair-mass structure; give a terminating exact membership law or separation certificate on finitely represented inputs; and, when the target is infeasible, return a certified closest loading and worst-case contamination over the declared bounded effect class. Add full-path augmented cross-fitted inference under either a correct generalized path propensity or correct full path-outcome mean. Consumer: the OpenTable state-of-emergency analysis and public ripw workflow, which gain interpretable current/lag target certification. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Gram matrices and loading numerators were reduced to linear functions of pair masses. Cofactor null vectors give rational inverse membership tests on every one-dimensional kernel stratum; exact rational checks cover 24 admissible four-period supports, full five-period support, and a seven-path six-period fiber whose three-dimensional linear kernel is uniquely resolved by pair-product compatibility. The repaired assignment model excludes the latent-selection counterexample, and full-mean augmentation returns the target under either nuisance branch. A support-uniform rational grid certifies global loss approximation, but generic lifting and small cases alone are insufficient. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Classify every positive compatible pair-mass intersection of the loading kernel and ratio-floor constraints for arbitrary absorbing support, yielding the structural boundary and exact membership procedure without generic quantifier elimination. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the seven-path six-period fiber at probabilities proportional to 1 through 7, enforce all pair-product compatibility equations, and recover the unique law; any method that drops it or admits incompatible positive kernel vectors must pivot. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/panel_dynamic_date_support_body.md.

open_problems.open_problem: For arbitrary finite absorbing-path support and a declared probability floor, characterize exactly which normalized calendar-by-causal-lag loading tensors are generated by positive reshaping laws and give a terminating exact membership or separation procedure for rational inputs.

source_refs.claim: The static DATE equation is a quadratic probability system treated through selected examples and nonlinear programming, while calendar-varying dynamic effects are left beyond scope.
source_refs.author: Dmitry Arkhangelsky, Guido W. Imbens, Lihua Lei, and Xiaoman Luo

source_refs.claim: Random adoption dates yield exact properties for a particular weighted effect, not an inverse characterization of every target attainable by changing the adoption-time law.
source_refs.author: Susan Athey and Guido W. Imbens

Replace the row-column map with an incidence map that explicitly includes calendar-time or calendar-residue diagonal mar

open_problems.why_unsolved: The published DATE analysis tests one target through a quadratic system and example-specific numerical work; it neither describes the full positive image nor certifies nonmembership. The rejected SNF proposal also omitted the calendar diagonal and reduced aliasing to a linear nullspace calculation. For the destination problem, that kernel is only an outer relaxation: pair masses arising from positive path laws obey multiplicative compatibility and ratio-floor restrictions. A solution must first derive the actual ordered Green representation of the two-way residualizer and then classify every intersection of its affine loading kernel with the positive pair-product variety.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient finite image theorem and exact terminating algorithm that returns either a positive rational reshaping law attaining the requested tensor or a checkable algebraic or inequality separation certificate.

writing_exemplar.why: Its framing moves from TWFE interpretability failure to assignment-law reshaping and then to feasibility of a requested causal weighting.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: A reshaping law acts like a counterfactual panel design -> only some causal weight tensors arise from positive designs -> characterize the complete dynamic image and decide exact membership

method_exemplars.technique: Extend the population Frisch-Waugh-Lovell reduction and necessary-and-sufficient DATE equation from static or homogeneous-dynamic weights to the uncollapsed calendar-by-lag system.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its quadratic DATE system is the immediate precursor of the requested inverse-image characterization.

method_exemplars.technique: Use toric ideals and factorization-compatible polynomial equalities to certify when proposed pair masses lift to a joint positive law.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The central obstruction is distinguishing positive linear-kernel vectors that satisfy pair-product compatibility from vectors that do not.

method_exemplars.technique: Apply fixed-weight imputation and its asymptotic-linear representation after the membership procedure selects an attainable loading tensor.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies inference for prespecified averages of heterogeneous panel effects once exact attainability is established.

open_problems.open_problem: For finite periods and memory under absorbing treatment-path support, derive the exact coefficient-by-calendar-time-by-causal-lag loading tensor of the unit/time fixed-effect event-study regression as an explicit function of a strictly positive reshaping law.

source_refs.claim: Its finite-memory dynamic analysis assumes calendar-time homogeneity and declares the time-varying dynamic DATE equation beyond scope.
source_refs.author: Dmitry Arkhangelsky, Guido W. Imbens, Lihua Lei, and Xiaoman Luo

source_refs.claim: Dynamic TWFE coefficients under staggered adoption mix cohort-period effects and can be contaminated by effects from other relative periods.
source_refs.author: Liyang Sun and Sarah Abraham

source_refs.claim: With carryover and serially correlated assignment, fixed-effect estimators need not recover an interpretable contemporaneous causal effect.
source_refs.author: Iavor Bojinov, Ashesh Rambachan, and Neil Shephard

open_problems.why_unsolved: The closest reshaping result collapses lag effects across calendar dates and explicitly leaves time-varying dynamics untreated. Sun-Abraham expose cohort and event-time contamination, while Bojinov-Rambachan-Shephard study carryover under known experimental assignment; neither supplies the joint calendar-by-lag map under a reshaped observational path law. The Frisch-Waugh-Lovell Gram and numerator calculation must therefore be redone with both indices retained.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A finite-dimensional theorem expressing every loading entry rationally in absorbing-path probabilities or ordered pair masses, with exact normalization, zero-sum contamination identities, and nonsingularity conditions.

writing_exemplar.why: Its motivation connects ordinary TWFE's design dependence to probability reshaping and isolates calendar-varying dynamics as the missing case.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: TWFE coefficients depend on treatment-path design -> reshape the assignment law to recover an interpretable DATE -> retain calendar time and causal lag jointly to obtain the missing loading tensor

method_exemplars.technique: Carry over the population Frisch-Waugh-Lovell Gram and loading-numerator reduction while enlarging the causal-effect basis to calendar-by-lag cells.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The requested tensor is the uncollapsed coefficient map underlying its static and homogeneous-dynamic probability limits.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt the auxiliary-regression decomposition expressing event-study coefficients as own-period and cross-period causal-effect weights.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It already exposes coefficient contamination cell by cell, but must be refined to calendar-by-causal-lag effects under reshaping.

method_exemplars.technique: Use imputation and asymptotic linearity for prespecified weighted averages after estimating untreated outcomes.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Once the tensor identifies a dynamic weighted effect, this provides the nearest established inference architecture.

open_problems.open_problem: When a requested calendar-by-causal-lag target tensor is unattainable, construct a certified globally closest positive-law loading, its exact worst-case contamination over a declared bounded effect class, and uniformly valid inference when the nearest face or active compatibility constraints change.

open_problems.why_unsolved: Existing diagnostics describe contamination for the realized design, while RIPW numerical routines seek exact feasibility; neither certifies a global projection onto the nonconvex positive loading body. The contamination calculation must optimize the residual loading over the stated effect class and connect its least-favorable array to the globally closest feasible point. Inference is additionally nonsmooth when the target crosses the body boundary, the nearest face changes, or the compatibility Jacobian loses rank. This requires tangent and normal cones for the pair-mass body and a directional derivative of its projection and support-function maps.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A terminating global algorithm with primal and dual distance certificates and an attained least-favorable contamination bound, accompanied by a directional limit theorem and uniformly valid confidence region or derivative-aware bootstrap at face intersections.

writing_exemplar.why: Its framing replaces failure of an exact identifying restriction with an explicit sensitivity class, sharp worst-case object, and usable certificate.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Exact causal interpretation may fail -> encode and optimize the admissible departure -> report a sharp conclusion with uncertainty; here the departure is loading infeasibility and the conclusion is certified contamination

method_exemplars.technique: Use its own-period versus cross-period loading decomposition to define the residual contamination operator.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The decomposition supplies the causal meaning of off-target calendar-lag loading that the certificate must bound.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt support-function optimization and least-favorable-element arguments from bounded trend violations to bounded dynamic-effect contamination.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Worst-case contamination is likewise an extremum of a known linear functional over a declared restriction set.

method_exemplars.technique: Apply the Hadamard directional delta method and derivative-aware resampling for nonsmooth projection functionals.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Projection onto a stratified feasible body is directionally but generally not fully differentiable at active-face changes.

open_problems.open_problem: Establish full-path augmented cross-fitted inference for a normalized calendar-by-causal-lag DATE tensor that is regular under the union of a correct generalized absorbing-path propensity model and a correct full conditional path-outcome mean model.

Resolve the uniform-attainment OEQ under a stated finite-cell plug-in scheme
Turn the inference handle into a concrete cross-fitted covariance learner and prove a unit-cluster Hájek linearization

open_problems.why_unsolved: Static RIPW robustness uses a panel-specific outcome-error metric because finite-period unit effects cannot be estimated consistently, and its dynamic analogues remain unproved. Existing doubly robust panel methods target group-time ATTs or sustained intervention means rather than a ratio-normalized regression-loading tensor. Moreover, the DATE loading depends on the estimated path-law Gram matrix and numerator. The missing proof must differentiate this generated loading inside both nuisance branches and find a common influence function; treating the weights as fixed omits first-order terms and does not resolve the earlier union-attainment obstruction.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A branchwise influence-function characterization and one explicit cross-fitted estimator with uniform asymptotic linearity, consistently estimated covariance, and a joint Gaussian or multiplier-bootstrap limit whenever either full-path nuisance branch is correct.

writing_exemplar.why: It supplies the RIPW terminology, OpenTable application, and robustness narrative that dynamic inference would complete.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Assignment reshaping repairs fixed-effect interpretation -> observational implementation requires estimated full-path nuisances -> augmentation and cross-fitting must preserve the normalized dynamic target under either nuisance branch

method_exemplars.technique: Extend derandomized cross-fitting, panel-specific orthogonal augmentation, and product-bias expansion from static DATE to the dynamic tensor and its normalization.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It uses the same reshaped assignment law, finite-period panel structure, and public ripw workflow.

method_exemplars.technique: Use foldwise orthogonalization and cross-fit remainder decompositions to isolate products of nuisance-estimation errors.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The target requires control of path-propensity, path-outcome, and generated-loading remainders without Donsker assumptions.

method_exemplars.technique: Analyze doubly robust inference with only one consistently estimated nuisance and explicitly characterize otherwise hidden drift terms.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The DATE score must remain inferentially valid, not merely consistent, on each one-correct-nuisance branch.

literature_map:
Arkhangelsky–Imbens–Lei–Luo (2024, Quantitative Economics, arXiv:2107.13737) introduces RIPW, the DATE equation, cross-fitting, and the OpenTable application; its dynamic analysis leaves calendar-varying effects beyond scope.
Sun–Abraham (2021, Journal of Econometrics, arXiv:1804.05785) derives event-study contamination weights across cohort-relative-time effects.
de Chaisemartin–D’Haultfœuille (2020, AER, DOI 10.1257/aer.20181169) shows static TWFE can be a negatively weighted sum of group-time effects.
Goodman-Bacon (2021, Journal of Econometrics, DOI 10.1016/j.jeconom.2021.03.014) decomposes staggered TWFE into two-group/two-period comparisons.
Athey–Imbens (2022, Journal of Econometrics, DOI 10.1016/j.jeconom.2020.10.012) obtains exact properties under randomized adoption dates for a particular weighted effect, not the full attainable-weight image.
Bojinov–Rambachan–Shephard (2021, Quantitative Economics, DOI 10.3982/QE1744) shows how carryover and serial assignment complicate fixed-effect causal interpretation.
Borusyak–Jaravel–Spiess (2024, Review of Economic Studies, arXiv:2108.12419) supplies imputation-based estimation and inference for prespecified heterogeneous-effect averages.
Callaway–Sant’Anna (2021, Journal of Econometrics, arXiv:1803.09015) provides doubly robust group-time ATT estimation and simultaneous inference.
Renson et al. (2023, Biometrics, DOI 10.1111/biom.13862) develops full-history doubly robust methods for sustained interventions, but not DATE loading tensors.
Rambachan–Roth (2023, Review of Economic Studies, DOI 10.1093/restud/rdad018) turns violations of identifying restrictions into sharp worst-case sensitivity objects.
The closest published DATE work uses selected closed forms and numerical optimization; it does not provide an arbitrary-support positive image theorem or exact separation certificate.
Searches combining calendar-varying DATE, pair-mass compatibility, exact membership, absorbing paths, and certified target projection found no published treatment of the requested target-method pair.
